newsitem.title: USA: EL SALVADOR AMENDS AMOUNT OF PL-480 VEGOIL TENDER.
newsitem.headline: EL SALVADOR AMENDS AMOUNT OF PL-480 VEGOIL TENDER.

text.p: El Salvador has amended the quantity range of its PL-480 vegoil tender for crude sunflowerseed oil in bulk to 750 to 1,500 tonnes instead of 750 to 1,240 tonnes as stated last week, its U.S. export agent said.
All other terms and conditions remained the same.
On August 5, El Salvador was also seeking approximately 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its agent said.
Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment.
Offers were due on August 14, the agent said.
